proposals.evidence: DEDR 4410 explicitly attests Tamil/Malayalam pēr, Kota pēr, Telugu pēru, Gadaba/Parji pidir, Gondi peder/porol, Tulu pudaru and Konda/Kuvi dōru name. The selected simple name nouns fit these branches; Indo-Aryan nām forms and potentially contact-mediated Kannada pēru are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR2562 compares Tamil cilanti/cilampi, Malayalam cilanni and Kannada seladi/selandi spider. The selected survey cil-/sel-/sol- plus nasal-stop forms fit this complete lexical family; the precise regional transmission remains open, and the explicitly questioned Toda comparison and transparent eight-legged compounds are excluded. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.

proposals.evidence: DEDR7 explicitly gives Tamil akaṅkai/aṅkai, Kannada aṅ-gey, Kodagu aŋgay and Tulu aṅgai palm, under akam inside; DEDR2023 gives kai/kay/key hand. Propose ordered inside + hand components, with contraction of akam in the compound. Survey minority-lect forms are comparative extensions and retain their original vowels and hand-stem endings.

proposals.evidence: DEDR474 and3918 explicitly document Tamil/Malayalam iru-patu/iru-vatu twenty, Kannada irpattu/ippattu, Kodagu iru-vadï and Kota irvād. Propose ordered two × ten components for the selected southern survey forms, preserving assimilated pp/bb, initial-glide variants and final vowels. Minority-lect forms are comparative extensions; neighbouring Gondi/Gadaba/Konda contact-sensitive numeral sets are excluded.

proposals.evidence: DEDR3918 explicitly gives Tamil paṉṉ-iraṇṭu/paṉṉaṇṭu twelve, the Kannada pann- combining form of ten and Kodagu panneraṇḍï; DEDR474 supplies two and the corresponding numeral formations. Propose ordered ten + two, retaining assimilation, Kannada h-/zero-initial variants and the survey vowel notation. These are whole-numeral comparative analyses, with no truncation of source responses; contact-sensitive Gondi/Gadaba/Konda sets are excluded.
